title: Mohenjo-daro mein 4,500 saal pehle drainage system tha!
source: Harappa.com · Wikipedia (Sanitation of the Indus Valley civilisation)

captions.instagram:
Hey, want to hear something? Covered drains... four and a half thousand years ago?

4,500 saal pehle Mohenjo-daro mein dhaki hui naaliyaan thi! 🧱 Safai ke liye uthne waale dhakkan, gharon ke bathroom seedhe sadak ki naali se jude — aur ek naali itni badi ki usme chal sakte ho!

Sources: Harappa.com, Wikipedia.
Photo: Emmanuel Dyan / Flickr (CC BY 2.0).
